title: refactor(cart): name the existing Spanish empty label
body:
## Change

In `web/src/emptyState.ts`, lift the existing Spanish label into `EMPTY_CART_LABEL` and return that private constant from `emptyCartLabel()`. The literal and public function stay unchanged.

## Motivation and boundary

A local name makes the current label easier to identify before any later catalog work. This patch adds no locale selection, fallback, or translations.

## Checks to perform

Call `emptyCartLabel()` before and after and compare the exact Unicode string, including the accent. Also run the TypeScript compiler to check the unchanged export. No checks are claimed as executed.
